Its chapter9verse5 reads ଯେମନ୍ତ where the selected Incubator witness reads ଯେବଣ; keep both readings distinct. Neither this comparison nor the modern compilation establishes a first coinage or a direction of borrowing.

entries.actual_visual_observation: Actual v3 full image at original detail: straight separate bar rests across anvil, held at remote end; unused tongs lie distinctly on stump. Prior tool/workpiece fusion resolved. Raised hammer, hands and bar support coherent for a simplified editorial cold-work scene. No glowing heated metal or reconstructed historical workshop asserted.

prior_versions.actual_visual_observation: Tong geometry ambiguous/impossible: apparent long lower jaw merges with bent workpiece on anvil while separate rod extends right. Need two distinct short jaws gripping one separate bar. Hammer and human pose otherwise coherent.

V2 shortens protruding right stub but lower tong member still visually continues into long bent bar over anvil. Distinct short jaws and separate workpiece are not convincingly resolved; no technical plausibility approval.

entries.caption_limit: Describe persistence at ironwork; do not say the smith grips hot iron or uses the resting tongs. This is a modern imagined illustration, not a technical training diagram.
